name: Fortus 450mc
summary: Industrial FDM for high-performance thermoplastics. Unlocks open parameters with OpenAM.

page.description: Stratasys Fortus 450mc 3D printer from IME Additive Manufacturing, Malaysia: specifications, applications and pricing.
page.headline: Factory-floor ready
page.lead: A 406 × 355 × 406 mm heated chamber and 18 standard, engineering and high-performance thermoplastics, plus open parameters through OpenAM, for prototypes, durable tooling and end-use parts.
page.footnote: * or ±0.0015 mm/mm, whichever is greater. Source: stratasys.com Fortus 450mc page, read 10 Nov 2026.
page.features_heading: A mid-size workhorse for engineering materials.

features.title: Colour options
features.text: Several materials, including ULTEM, come in colours, cutting paint steps.

features.title: OpenAM
features.text: Optional licence to tune parameters and run open materials.

benefits.title: Spacious build
benefits.text: Larger parts or several smaller parts per build.

specs.label: Accuracy
specs.value: ±0.127 mm or ±0.0015 mm/mm, whichever is greater; Z adds slice-height tolerance (95 % dimensional yield)

specs.label: Materials
specs.value: Includes FDM PA6/66-GF30-FR, FDM Nylon 12CF, ULTEM 9085, ULTEM 1010, Antero 800NA (PEKK), PC-ESD, VICTREX AM 200 PEEK, ASA (12 colours), ABS-M30i (biocompatible); open materials with OpenAM

specs.label: Material delivery
specs.value: Two bays each for model and support canisters, automatic changeover; Fortus FDC optional

specs.label: Software
specs.value: GrabCAD Print, GrabCAD Print Pro, Insight, Control Center; OpenAM optional

specs.label: Compliance
specs.value: CE, cTUVus, RCM, EAC, FCC Part B

page.applications_heading: Prototypes, tooling and end-use parts in engineering plastics.
page.applications_text: From ABS and ASA to ULTEM, PEKK and PEEK, on one machine.
